# KaTeX runtime

Vendored from `katex@0.18.5` (MIT) for the build-free website.

Included files:

- `katex.min.js`
- `katex.min.css`
- the WOFF2 fonts referenced by the stylesheet
- the upstream `LICENSE`

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.18.5>

The unminified sources and other distribution formats are available from the
upstream package. KaTeX is loaded locally so the mathematical examples keep
working offline and under a restrictive network policy.
